description: Base de données AIS trafic maritime Caraïbes 2019 is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by doi.org. “PostGre/PostGIS database gathering trajectories calculated from the positions of all vessels detected by AIS (Automatic Identification System) in the Caribbean in 2019. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "AIS maritime traffic database Caribbean 2019" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include OHM Littoral Caraïbe. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
